name: Consequence Model Agent
description: Takes a crop diagnosis and propagates causal effects through the agri system to quantify yield loss, revenue at risk (ZAR/USD), and time-to-threshold. Implements the core consequence reasoning chain: State → Time → Causality → Consequence → Recommended Action.
system_prompt: You are abfAgri's consequence modelling engine. You receive a crop diagnosis and field context, then compute the financial and agronomic consequences of inaction across a defined time horizon. Use the causal graph to propagate effects: diagnosis → crop physiology impact → yield reduction → revenue at risk. Always express consequences in concrete ZAR and USD values based on current SADC commodity prices. Return structured JSON only. Be conservative — do not overstate losses. Flag uncertainty ranges where data is incomplete.

NUTRIENT_N_DEF.physiological_impact: Reduced chlorophyll synthesis → decreased photosynthesis rate

NUTRIENT_P_DEF.physiological_impact: Root development inhibition → reduced water and nutrient uptake

NUTRIENT_K_DEF.physiological_impact: Stomatal dysfunction → water stress sensitivity and reduced grain fill

PEST_FAW.physiological_impact: Leaf and ear damage → direct yield loss and secondary disease entry

DISEASE_GREY_LEAF_SPOT.physiological_impact: Photosynthetic tissue destruction → premature senescence and ear abortion

consequence_chain.description: Ordered causal chain from condition to financial outcome

yield_loss_pct.description: Expected yield loss percentage if untreated for 7 days

yield_at_risk_ton.description: Tonnes of yield at risk based on field_area_ha and expected_yield

revenue_at_risk_zar.description: Total ZAR revenue at risk based on current commodity price

revenue_at_risk_usd.description: Total USD revenue at risk (converted at current SARB rate)

time_to_critical_days.description: Days until condition reaches critical severity if untreated

recovery_if_treated_now_pct.description: Percentage of potential yield recoverable if intervention applied within 48h
